### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20884 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?


What's Changed:

How it Works:

1. `tryToGetBroadCastJoin` will try to get broadcast join plan without checking the new collation status.
2. `PhysicalBroadCastJoin.ToPB` will fill `ProbeTypes` and `BuildTypes` so TiFlash will get the collation information to do the join.

issue_context.title: TiDB push down broadcast join to TiFlash even if new collation is on
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->
Since TiFlash support broadcast join, TiDB will convert a join to broadcast join based on the CBO, however, in the past, TiFlash broadcast join does not support new collation, so TiDB will not convert a join to broadcast join if the new collation is on.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->
Now TiFlash already support broadcast with new collation, so TiDB can push down broadcast join to TiFlash even if new collation is on.

**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. -->

**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**
<!-- If you can, explain some scenarios how users might use this, situations it would be helpful in. Any API designs, mockups, or diagrams are also helpful. -->

review_comments: may I ask why we have both `probeFiledTypes` and `buildFiledTypes` if they are same?
They are copied from `HashJoinExec`, actually in TiFlash only one is needed, I set both `probeFieldTypes` and `buildFieldTypes` in `DAGRequest` just to keep it the same with TiDB.
